bio: Treat yourself to a regal Afternoon Tea experience at Royal Lancaster London, served  in the elegant and relaxed Hyde Café. Savour an irresistible assortment of delicate finger sandwiches, homemade scones and sweet delicacies inspired by the season and for that added treat, add a glass of Chapel Down sparkling wine whilst the afternoon blissfully slips away. Gluten free, dairy free, vegan and vegetarian alternatives are also available  Royal Lancaster London is perfectly located moments from Hyde Park, just a short walk away from both Lancaster Gate and Paddington stations and in 2019, was awarded a Commended certificate at the Afternoon Tea Awards in recognition of its quality Afternoon Tea service.  Afternoon Tea is priced from £45pp Monday - Friday and from £49pp on Saturdays and Sundays.
